projects.name: Fieldnode
projects.idea: Fieldnode is a B2B platform for the energy and heavy industries that enables companies to manage digital spare parts, streamline qualification and RFQ workflows, and manufacture parts on demand through a global network of verified suppliers.

projects.name: Fieldnode - Design System
projects.idea: Built a Design System on top of the shadcn library, using its foundation while creating a more structured and scalable component architecture.

projects.name: Scholarsapp
projects.idea: ScholarsApp is an EdTech platform that connects students with relevant scholarship opportunities while simplifying the entire application and scholarship management process for students, counselors, and donors.

projects.name: RoadManTech - RMT
projects.idea: RoadManTech is a B2B SaaS platform for roadway and infrastructure management that helps government agencies monitor pavement conditions, manage maintenance work, and optimize infrastructure budgets using real-time data and analytics.

projects.name: HisLovers Design System
projects.idea: Design system built from scratch for B2C product, called HisLovers. That system have 450 components inside

projects.name: HisLovers

projects.name: Samsung ADS
projects.idea: Samsung Ads is a connected TV advertising platform that helps brands reach, target, and measure audiences across Samsung Smart TVs, Samsung TV Plus, and the wider Samsung ecosystem.

projects.name: bloBrew - Brand Identity
projects.idea: Developed a complete brand identity for bloBrew, covering logo system, colors, typography, digital applications, and print/packaging guidelines.

projects.name: Tom Yum - Brand Identity
projects.idea: Built TomYum’s brand identity from the ground up, defining its visual and verbal language across logo, colors, typography, imagery, voice & tone, digital products, social media, and branded merchandise.

projects.name: bloBrew
projects.idea: bloBrew a blockchain-based Web3 platform that connects luxury liquor bottles to unique NFTs, serving as proof of authenticity, ownership, and redemption rights. It allows collectors to securely store, trade, or claim premium spirits without physically handling them until desired.
